description_ar: أسئلة مباشرة حول المضارع والماضي البسيط والمستمر والمضارع التام والماضي التام والمستقبل

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: has lived. 'since 2015' is a point in time linking past to now, so we use the present perfect: has + V3.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: has lived. since + نقطة زمنية يتطلب المضارع التام (has + V3).
questions.memorization_note: $\text{since} + \text{نقطة زمنية}$ (2015, Monday, last year) ، $\text{for} + \text{مدة}$ (two hours, ten years) — كلاهما مع المضارع التام: $\text{have/has} + V_3$

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: saw. 'yesterday' is a finished past time, so the past simple (saw) is used.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: saw. yesterday وقت ماضٍ محدد ← الماضي البسيط saw.
questions.memorization_note: كلمات الماضي المحدد (yesterday, last night, ago, in 2010) ← الماضي البسيط $V_2$ ولا يُستعمل معها المضارع التام.

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: had already started. The film started before I arrived, so the earlier action takes the past perfect: had + V3.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: had already started. الفيلم بدأ قبل وصولي (الأسبق) ← الماضي التام had + V3.
questions.memorization_note: الماضي التام: $\text{had} + V_3$ للحدث الأسبق من حدثين ماضيين (when, before, by the time).

questions.question_en: At 8 o'clock last night, we ___ dinner.
questions.question_ar: في الساعة 8 ليلة أمس، كنا ____ العشاء.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: were having. An action in progress at a specific past time takes the past continuous: were + V-ing.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: were having. حدث مستمر في وقت محدد في الماضي ← الماضي المستمر were + V-ing.
questions.memorization_note: المستمر: $\text{am/is/are} + V\text{-ing}$ (now, Look!) ، والماضي المستمر: $\text{was/were} + V\text{-ing}$ (while, at 8 o'clock last night).

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: is sleeping. 'Look!' signals an action happening now: present continuous (is + V-ing).
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: is sleeping. Look! تدل على حدث الآن ← المضارع المستمر is + V-ing.
questions.memorization_note: المستمر: $\text{am/is/are} + V\text{-ing}$ (now, Look!) ، والماضي المستمر: $\text{was/were} + V\text{-ing}$ (while, at 8 o'clock last night).

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: boils. A scientific fact is expressed with the present simple: boils.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: boils. الحقيقة العلمية ← المضارع البسيط boils.
questions.memorization_note: الحقائق العلمية والعادات والجداول ← المضارع البسيط: $S + V_1\,(s/es)$

questions.question_en: While I ___ TV, the phone rang.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: was watching. 'While' + a longer action interrupted by a short one takes the past continuous: was watching.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: was watching. while + حدث طويل مقطوع ← الماضي المستمر was watching.
questions.memorization_note: المستمر: $\text{am/is/are} + V\text{-ing}$ (now, Look!) ، والماضي المستمر: $\text{was/were} + V\text{-ing}$ (while, at 8 o'clock last night).

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: have you worked. 'How long' (duration up to now) takes the present perfect: have you worked.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: have you worked. How long (مدة حتى الآن) ← المضارع التام have you worked.
questions.memorization_note: المضارع التام $\text{have/has} + V_3$ مع (ever, never, so far, just, How long).

questions.question_en: By the time we got to the station, the train ___.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: had left. The train left before we arrived (earlier action): past perfect had left.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: had left. القطار غادر قبل وصولنا (الأسبق) ← الماضي التام had left.
questions.memorization_note: الماضي التام: $\text{had} + V_3$ للحدث الأسبق من حدثين ماضيين (when, before, by the time).

questions.question_en: Tom ___ for the company since last year.
questions.question_ar: توم ____ في الشركة منذ العام الماضي.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: has worked. 'since last year' needs the present perfect: has worked.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: has worked. since last year يتطلب المضارع التام has worked.
questions.memorization_note: $\text{since} + \text{نقطة زمنية}$ (2015, Monday, last year) ، $\text{for} + \text{مدة}$ (two hours, ten years) — كلاهما مع المضارع التام: $\text{have/has} + V_3$

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: leaves. Official timetables for the future use the present simple: leaves.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: leaves. الجداول الرسمية للمستقبل ← المضارع البسيط leaves.
questions.memorization_note: الحقائق العلمية والعادات والجداول ← المضارع البسيط: $S + V_1\,(s/es)$

questions.question_en: By next year, she ___ her degree.
questions.question_ar: بحلول العام القادم، ستكون قد ____ شهادتها.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: will have finished. 'By + future time' takes the future perfect: will have + V3.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: will have finished. by + وقت مستقبلي ← المستقبل التام will have finished.
questions.memorization_note: $\text{by next year}$ ← المستقبل التام: $\text{will have} + V_3$

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: yet. 'yet' is used at the end of questions and negatives with the present perfect.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: yet. yet تُستعمل في آخر الأسئلة والنفي مع المضارع التام.
questions.memorization_note: $\text{yet}$ للسؤال والنفي (في آخر الجملة) ، $\text{already}$ للمثبت ، $\text{still}$ قبل الفعل الرئيسي.

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: eaten. After have/has we need the past participle (V3): eaten.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: eaten. بعد have/has نستخدم التصريف الثالث V3: eaten.
questions.memorization_note: المضارع التام $\text{have/has} + V_3$ مع (ever, never, so far, just, How long).

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: gave up. 'two years ago' is a finished time, so past simple: gave up.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: gave up. ago تدل على ماضٍ منتهٍ ← الماضي البسيط gave up.
questions.memorization_note: كلمات الماضي المحدد (yesterday, last night, ago, in 2010) ← الماضي البسيط $V_2$ ولا يُستعمل معها المضارع التام.
